title: Fix VAT adjustment register
summary: Fixes how the VAT adjustment register is handled when posting through the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit, with a one-line change in each localization layer. New tests were added to the W1 and CZ ERMPmtDiscAndVATCustVend test codeunits.
key_points: One-line fix in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line for the VAT adjustment register
Applied in the W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
